name: RSICap and RSIEval
description: RSICap is a high-quality Remote Sensing Image Captioning dataset with 2,585 human-annotated captions providing detailed scene and object descriptions. RSIEval is a benchmark evaluation dataset consisting of human-annotated captions and visual question-answer pairs designed to comprehensively assess vision language models in remote sensing.
reputation: A newer remote-sensing captioning and VQA benchmark that is emerging as a useful evaluation set for vision-language models in the geospatial domain.
notes: Dataset is relatively small scale (2,585 captions) but human-annotated with rich detail; benchmark includes both captioning and VQA tasks for remote sensing.
